'''Dominic Larson''' is a [[Forsaken]] quest giver located in [[Stillward Church]] in [[Gilneas]]. In life, he was a soldier loyal to [[Gilneas (kingdom)|Gilneas]] and participated in the defeat of the [[Scourge]] at the battle of [[Ruins of Greyshire|Greyshire]]. However, he was killed by the worgen [[Snarlclaw]], which had ambushed him and his unit.<ref>{{questlong|Horde|47+|Revenge After Death}}</ref>
